The Mahalanobis-optimal z weight is therefore about 0.8-0.88, and 0.6 overshoots it further than the current 1.0 undershoots. The expected sign on an unseen embryo is not positive, if anything slightly negative. The enlarged z ball (11.7/16.7 um) also admits more z-distant wrong candidates. (2) There is no lab sign and no LB read. The CPU replay churn is 0.05-1.3% of edges with nodes about 0, and relink-knob gains have transferred at about +0.001 at most. The EV is about 0. (3) Our records already refuted it as an unbuilt spare (I-454; knobarms rank.json ranked it last; absent from W4 AMEND 4). It is outside the whitelist and needs a user yes. A morning GPU slot is better left UNUSED or given to a higher-prior candidate.
